title: Jesus Calms the Storm
description: Jesus and his disciples were crossing the sea in a boat when a violent storm broke out. Jesus was sleeping, but the disciples woke him in fear. He rebuked the wind and the waves: "Be quiet! Be still!" It became completely calm, and the disciples wondered who he was.

versions.title: Jesus Calms the Storm
versions.description: Jesus calmed a violent storm on the Sea of Galilee by rebuking the wind and the waves: "Be quiet! Be still!"
